statement: Save selected elements as a module file (.mod) that can be placed in other projects as a hotlink and kept in sync.

source.ref: Hotlink Modules > Save Selection as Module

superiority: Modules are first-class referenced assets with versioning and diff.

acceptance.sketch: Create module from 10 elements; place into another project: 10 elements appear at the anchor point.

notes: VERIFIED — read Save Selection as Module and Create Module (.mod) File; .mod holds model and floor plan data only, with story/element filters in Save Options.

statement: Place a module with a chosen master layer, orientation, project-origin or survey-point alignment and story matching, producing protected linked content in the host project.
superiority: Placement transform is a single editable object and can be driven by script.

acceptance.sketch: Placing at (5,5) with 30 degrees rotates and offsets all content consistently within 1e-9.

notes: CORRECTED — read Place Hotlink; options are master layer, orientation, align at origin/survey point, master ID, design options and story matching; 'anchor' and 'locked' are not the help's terms.

statement: Update placed modules from the Hotlink Module Manager when the source file is modified, refreshing every instance and optionally opening Model Compare to show what changed.
superiority: Updates preview a diff before applying.

acceptance.sketch: A source change shows in the host after update and local overrides are listed.

notes: CORRECTED — read Hotlink Module Manager, Edit Hotlink Module Content and About Hotlink Modules; hotlinked elements cannot be edited locally so no conflict options; Model Compare after update is optional.

statement: Convert a placed hotlink into ordinary editable elements by breaking the link and embedding its elements in the host project.

source.ref: Hotlink Modules > Edit Hotlink Module Content

superiority: Break keeps provenance metadata on elements.

acceptance.sketch: After break link the elements are editable and no link entry remains.

notes: VERIFIED — read Edit Hotlink Module Content and Hotlink Module Manager; Break Hotlink (Embed Elements) per instance, Break Link per module; not available in Teamwork (Explode used there).

statement: Relink a hotlink whose source file is reported missing to a new file location, replacing all hotlinks of that source.
superiority: Path resolution by project-relative IDs.

acceptance.sketch: Relink resolves path; update works.

notes: CORRECTED — read Hotlink Module Manager; Relink is for Missing sources, clears the undo queue, works only on top-level modules, IFC must be relinked to IFC; swap to another module is HOTLINK-0014.

statement: A manager dialog lists hotlink modules in a nested hierarchy and their source files with status, size, modified and last-updated dates, and location.
superiority: Dependency graph visualisation across projects.

acceptance.sketch: Manager lists all links with correct statuses.

notes: VERIFIED — read Hotlink Module Manager; includes Update, Relink, Open in New Instance, Change Module, Save as File, Break Link, Delete and nested-module skip/include.

statement: Attributes arriving with a hotlink are matched by name to host attributes, and the host attribute is used when same-named ones differ.

source.ref: Attributes > Handling of attributes during paste and hotlink

superiority: Conflicts previewed before merge.

acceptance.sketch: Merge mode adds attributes only when absent and reports the attributes added.

notes: CORRECTED — read Handling of attributes during paste and hotlink; new names create new attributes, same names reuse host definition, pen sets and layer combinations are not transferred.

statement: Hotlink modules can themselves contain nested modules, which can be skipped or included per placed hotlink or for all hotlinks of a module.
superiority: Cycle detection with clear error.

acceptance.sketch: A nested module resolves and updates through two levels.

notes: CORRECTED — read Hotlink Settings and Hotlink Module Manager; several nesting levels allowed, IFC/Rhino modules cannot contain nested modules; no fixed depth limit stated.

statement: When placing a multistory module, a story-matching dialog assigns module stories to host stories, and module stories with no host story stay invisible until stories are added.
superiority: Automatic mapping by elevation with manual override.

acceptance.sketch: Module story 1 maps to host story 3 and elements land at the correct elevation.

notes: VERIFIED — read Place Hotlink (Match Stories dialog) and Merging Files; counts may differ, unmatched stories not shown.

statement: Elements of a placed hotlink can be edited only as a whole entity, not individually, though they can be selected and found with Find and Select.
superiority: Per-element unlock with provenance warning.

acceptance.sketch: An edit of a module element in the host is refused, while snapping to it works.

notes: VERIFIED — read About Hotlink Modules; hotspots are shown as hollow squares; edit via source file or break the link.

statement: Replace a single placed hotlink by a different module through its hotlink settings while keeping its placement.
superiority: Swap with preview of differences.

acceptance.sketch: Swapping a module keeps the anchor and rotation of the placement.

notes: CORRECTED — read Hotlink Settings (Change Module); keeping exact position on swap is not stated explicitly; module-wide change is HOTLINK-0014.

statement: Missing files are reported, keeping last cached copy.
superiority: Hash-based relink suggestion.

acceptance.sketch: A missing source shows a warning while the cached copy keeps displaying.

notes: VERIFIED — read About Hotlink Modules and Hotlink Module Manager; modules stay present and visible when source is missing, but cannot be updated until relinked.

statement: Hotlink modules suit repetitive structures such as hotel rooms or offices, where editing one source file updates all placed copies.
superiority: Instances are lightweight references.

acceptance.sketch: Twenty instances of one module update together after a source edit.

notes: VERIFIED — read About Hotlink Modules; same structures reusable across projects; placement parameters per instance may differ.

statement: Replace a module with a different module for all its placed hotlinks from the manager, except for nested modules.
superiority: Path resolution by stable project-relative ID, not absolute paths.

acceptance.sketch: Relink resolves path and update works.

notes: CORRECTED — read Hotlink Module Manager (Change Module); not available for nested modules; relink of a missing source is HOTLINK-0005.

statement: Incoming hotlink attributes are matched by name, new names are created in the host, and differing same-named attributes use the host definition.

source.ref: Attributes > Handling of attributes during paste and hotlink

superiority: Conflict resolution UI with preview.

acceptance.sketch: Merge adds new attributes and leaves existing unchanged.

notes: CORRECTED — read Handling of attributes during paste and hotlink; per-type conflict table (profiles, composites, surfaces, fills, zone categories); overlaps HOTLINK-0007.

statement: Hotlinked elements cannot be edited in the host but can be selected as a unit and located with Find and Select.
superiority: Per-element unlock with provenance warning.

acceptance.sketch: An edit attempt is refused; snap to a corner works.

notes: CORRECTED — read About Hotlink Modules; snapping to hotlinked elements is not documented on the page; overlaps HOTLINK-0010.

statement: Place an IFC file as a protected hotlink module using an import translator, and update it when the file changes.

source.ref: Working with IFC > Hotlink IFC File

superiority: Reference models share the same link manager as modules.

acceptance.sketch: IFC reference updates after the file changes.

notes: VERIFIED — read Hotlink IFC File; elements converted by chosen import translator; elevation option should be Keep Elevation; update via Hotlink Module Manager.

statement: Missing source files are reported while the last cached copy remains.
superiority: Content hash allows relinking.

acceptance.sketch: Cached copy displays and a warning lists the missing path.

notes: VERIFIED — read Hotlink Module Manager and About Hotlink Modules; Missing status shown, relink offered; overlaps HOTLINK-0012.

statement: Create reusable modules for typical flats, bathrooms or facade bays from selected elements and place many instances with their own master IDs.
superiority: Instances are lightweight references.

acceptance.sketch: 20 instances share one source and update together.

notes: VERIFIED — read Hotlink Settings and Create Module (.mod) File; Master ID extends element IDs per instance (e.g. room number).

statement: Each placed hotlink has a master layer controlling its visibility and locking as a whole, and an optional master ID appended to the IDs of its elements and zones.
superiority: Master IDs can be generated from a table such as a room schedule.

acceptance.sketch: Place the same module twice on different master layers: hiding one layer hides one instance only; a master ID R213 gives every element of that instance an ID extended by R213.

notes: ADDED+VERIFIED — read Hotlink Settings; elements keep their own layers inside the module.

statement: Open a hotlink source file in a separate program instance to edit it, then return and update the host when the manager reports the source as modified.
superiority: The edit instance could show the host context live instead of a separate trace.

acceptance.sketch: Edit and save a source, then refresh status: source shows Modified with newer modification date than last update; Update changes all instances.

notes: ADDED+VERIFIED — read Hotlink Module Manager and Edit Hotlink Module Content; edit-in-new-instance is not available for IFC or Rhino modules.

statement: In a shared project a placed hotlink cannot be broken but can be exploded per instance, and each instance can be reserved, requested and moved like any element.

source.ref: Teamwork > Hotlink Modules and XREFs in Teamwork

superiority: Explode can keep a back-reference to the source for later re-link.

acceptance.sketch: In a shared project Break Link is unavailable while Explode converts one instance to editable elements and leaves other instances linked.

notes: ADDED+VERIFIED — read Hotlink Modules and XREFs in Teamwork; placing a hotlink reserves the instance automatically.

statement: Placing, relinking and updating hotlinks and attaching external references in a shared project require separate access rights, and the manager is reserved automatically during an update.

source.ref: Teamwork > Hotlink Modules and XREFs in Teamwork

superiority: The rights check can report which missing permission blocked an action.

acceptance.sketch: A user without the hotlink-manage right cannot place a new hotlink but, with the instances right, can update; update refreshes all instances regardless of owner.

notes: ADDED+VERIFIED — read Hotlink Modules and XREFs in Teamwork; rights named Hotlink and XREF - Manage and Hotlink - Instances.

statement: Attach a DWG or DXF file as an external reference with a translator, choosing attachment or overlay handling of nested references, and update it when the source changes.
superiority: XREFs can include a diff view against the previous state of the reference.

acceptance.sketch: Attach BASE.DWG that itself attaches COMMON.DWG: both show; with overlay type only BASE shows; editing the DWG then reloading updates the drawing.

notes: ADDED+VERIFIED — read Attach XREF, Working with XREFs and Attributes of XREF Files; XREF layers are prefixed XREF_NAME|LAYER and partial open can drop layers.

statement: Properties and classifications arriving with a hotlink are searchable, schedulable and read-only in the host, with new ones shown greyed until merged into the host definitions.

source.ref: Properties and Classification Systems > Properties and Classifications in Hotlinks

superiority: Merge conflicts can be previewed with a per-property diff.

acceptance.sketch: A module with property P not in the host shows P greyed and searchable; editing P in host is refused; Merge makes it a host property.

notes: ADDED+VERIFIED — read Properties and Classifications in Hotlinks.

statement: Import E57 or XYZ point cloud files as placeable objects, mapping XYZ columns to coordinates and colours, then move their origin and override floor plan display range to trace elements.
superiority: Large clouds can be streamed in levels of detail with spatial tiling.

acceptance.sketch: Import an XYZ file with columns reordered: assigning columns to X, Y, Z and RGB places points correctly; invalid duplicate assignment disables OK.

notes: ADDED+VERIFIED — read Import Point Clouds, Redefine Origin of Point Cloud Object and Optimize Display of Point Cloud Object; Teamwork needs the created objects added to BIMcloud libraries.

statement: Place an external drawing file, including selected pages of a PDF, as a drawing in a model view or on a layout, linked to its source file or BIMcloud location.

source.ref: Documentation > Place Drawing in Model View

superiority: PDF pages could stay vector-snappable like CAD references.

acceptance.sketch: Place page 3 of a PDF as a drawing: only that page appears; relinking to a replaced PDF updates the content.

notes: ADDED+VERIFIED — read Place Drawing in Model View and Place Drawing on Layout; Drawing tool places one PDF page at a time, the File menu command can place several.

statement: Place a Rhino 3dm or Revit rvt file as a hotlink module with per-module import options such as layer and surface conversion, viewable as conversion info in the manager.
superiority: Import options could be saved as reusable presets across modules.

acceptance.sketch: Hotlink a 3dm file with a chosen surface conversion: the manager shows the module's import settings; Rhino segmentation settings cannot be changed after placement.

notes: ADDED+VERIFIED — read Hotlink Rhino File and Hotlink 3D RVT Model; RVT options include generating attributes or using one uniform building material.
